description: Frame budgets (ADR-0018): per path scene and resolution, the GPU milliseconds per pass at the median and the p99 of the path's frames, and the frame thread's cpu_ms, that a merge may not push a run past (beyond the tolerance). tools/frame-budget.ps1 is the gate; docs/subsystems/bench.md "Frame budgets" is the format and how to re-baseline.

baseline.reason: Measured drift, not a change under test: on 2026-10-12 main's own installed binary (f8ed3892) and the batch 16 tree measure the same, endless-surround3-rt hw median 0.43 ms against 0.323 on 2026-10-11 19:30 and cull 0.085 against 0.068 (three flights each, no rebuilds), and endless-1080p-csm total median 3.08-3.2 against the 2026-10-07 seed 2.916 after the HDR encode, F18 and the fold guard each landed within tolerance; the 1080p cull/sky/resolve p99 tails spike about 2x on main too (one of three quiet flights), so the p99 absolute slack goes from 0.1 to 0.4 ms in the same change
